Package gui

Class SubscriberVisitHistoryController

java.lang.Object
gui.SubscriberVisitHistoryController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IVisitHistory, Initializable
public class SubscriberVisitHistoryController extends Object implements Initializable, IVisitHistory
Controller for the Subscriber Visit History view. This class handles the UI logic for searching and displaying the past visits of a specific subscriber based on their unique ID. It implements Initializable for JavaFX setup and IVisitHistory to receive data from the server via the ClientController.
